verdict.reason: Verified against the local files: build-epk-kit.py has no JSON emission (grep finds none), build-epk-ai.py records ops via Ops/Recorder and dumps them with json.dumps into the JSX (line 438) plus links.json (line 441), and kit.para() does draw line-by-line via simpleSplit+textOut (lines 255-276); however the "one element per line" consequence is wrong because install() replaces kit.para with a recorder that emits one "area" op per paragraph block and kit.tracked with one "point" op per heading, and the Recorder has no beginText/textOut/drawText methods, so a Canva emitter reusing the same recording canvas gets paragraph-level text elements, not per-line ones.
verdict.correction: Replace "so a naive replay produces one element per line" with: "but build-epk-ai.py's install() swaps kit.para for a recorder that emits a single 'area' op per paragraph block (text, x, top, w, h, font, size, lead, fill, align, min, gap — see Ops.area at ~line 124 and install() at ~lines 236-241) and kit.tracked for one 'point' op per heading; the Recorder has no beginText/textOut, so per-line drawing never happens during recording. A Canva emitter reusing this recorder receives paragraph-level text elements it can map to Canva text boxes, and only a fresh replay against the raw reportlab canvas would produce one element per line."
